title: Noblestalk

sources.title: Find the Mushroom Picker
markers: | description = Find the Mushroom Picker is a quest in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by talking to Derryth Bonecloak in Ebonlake Grotto.

sources.title: A Familiar Face
markers: | description = A Familiar Face is a sub-quest of both {{CharLink|Shadowheart|Shadowheart's}} {{Quest|Daughter of Darkness|Companion quest}} and her {{Quest|Daughter of Darkness (Origin)|Origin quest}}. It is acquired if Shadowheart consumes the Noblestalk in the Underdark.

summary: Consume as an Action to restore full HP and remove negative conditions. The unique Underdark specimen can also restore memories.

fields.Underdark specimen: Recover in the Bibberbang Grotto. Igniting the spores destroys it. Extinguish the torch before setting off the mushrooms, or use Mage Hand to drag it without throwing it.
fields.Memory choices: Give to Baelen to restore his mental faculties, consume as the Dark Urge to recover a memory, or persuade companion Shadowheart to eat it and start A Familiar Face. Origin Shadowheart can choose directly. Restoring a memory grants A Noble Endeavour to Outlanders.
fields.Other choices: Give it to Derryth in the Underdark to unlock three daily-restocking Noblestalk at Bonecloak’s Apothecary in Act Three. Her stock heals and clears conditions without restoring memories. Giving it to Thulla cures Duergar Poison.
fields.Base value: 75 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Consume: Action. Restore all HP and remove negative conditions.
